name: Sustainability (ESG) reporting assurance
payer: Reporting company pays the assurance provider.
publication: Assurance statement published with the report; usually limited assurance.
ai_analogue: Two decades of voluntary, company-paid, limited assurance before a mandate; independence rules borrowed wholesale from financial audit rather than designed for the domain.

milestones.event: Global Reporting Initiative founded; voluntary reporting framework.
AA1000 Assurance Standard published; voluntary third-party assurance spreads.
Volkswagen emissions scandal undermines self-reported environmental claims.
EU Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive requires limited assurance, phasing in from 2024.
